_doc: Phase 2 long-simulation golden manifest. Generated by capture_longsim.php against the REAL devsam-core executeAllCommand inner block. The long-sim is a structural/oracle gate — state snapshots are the parity target, not per-general command sequences (AI choices are seed-dependent and may differ between PHP and Kotlin).
hiddenSeedProvenance: config-file UniqueConst.php::$hiddenSeed (32-char lowercase hex, bin2hex(random_bytes(16))). Captured live per install; committed as the capture-00-baseline.json fixture INPUT.
tickBodyPortTarget: TurnExecutionHelper.php:executeAllCommand inner block: executeGeneralCommandUntil -> runEventHandler PreMonth -> preUpdateMonthly -> turnDate -> checkStatistic if month==1 -> runEventHandler Month -> postUpdateMonthly.
assertions: install baseline pristine — year==startYear && month==1 && isunited==0
turnDate advances exactly 1 month per tick: (newYear*12 + newMonth) == (oldYear*12 + oldMonth) + 1
isunited remains in {0,2} — 0=running, 2=천통(unification); abort on 1 or 3 (InvaderEnding states)
general_record.id monotonically increases — no row deletion or ID reuse within a capture run
nation count with level>0 >= 1 until unification
no PHP fatal errors or unhandled exceptions — E_ERROR/E_PARSE still surface
max-turn boundary: if loop reaches maxTurns without unification, emit final snapshot and exit 0 (partial long-sim is still valuable)
turntime advances monotonically: prevTurn < nextTurn after each addTurn()
risks: NPC AI path divergence — GeneralAI.chooseNationTurn/chooseGeneralTurn may pick different commands than the Kotlin AI port; the long-sim is a structural/oracle gate, not a draw-for-draw gate for AI choices.
No human players — all turns are NPC/autorun. Human-player commands are NOT exercised.
No reserved turns on pristine install — early months may have zero command drain until turntime advances.
RNG draw count for per-general commands is NOT captured individually — only monthly RNG draw count is tracked.
In a NPC-only sim with no combat commands, unification may NEVER happen. maxTurns boundary is the escape hatch.
Tournament and auction infrastructure is skipped — processTournament()/processAuction() are real-time triggered, not monthly-bound.
Memory growth — full table dumps every 12 months for 360 months = significant JSON size.
MariaDB-only features — reset.sql/schema.sql use ENGINE=Aria. MySQL 8 will fail.
Install non-idempotency — each run generates a new hiddenSeed. Captures are seed-specific.
Autorun limit bookkeeping — executeGeneralCommandUntil sets autorun_limit for user generals; in headless sim this path is a no-op.

rngLineages.monthly: simpleSerialize(hiddenSeed,'monthly',year,month) — built ONCE per month, passed ONLY to postUpdateMonthly. Captured monthlyRngDraws per month.
rngLineages.perGeneral: preprocess/nationCommand/generalCommand forks — consumed inline during executeGeneralCommandUntil; NOT separately instrumented.

dispatchOrderOracle.rule: event rows ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC (runEventHandler / EventStore.rowsFor).

stateTables: game_env — KV: year, month, startyear, turnterm, develcost, isunited, turntime, hiddenSeed
nation — whole table, ORDER BY nation ASC
city — whole table, ORDER BY city ASC
general — whole table, ORDER BY no ASC
diplomacy — whole table, ORDER BY no ASC
nation_env — KV rows, ORDER BY firstColumn ASC
general_record — delta only: rows added since last capture point (id > highWaterMark), ORDER BY id ASC

capture-00-baseline.json.hiddenSeed: 32-char hex string — per-game install seed, fixture INPUT

state.game_env: KV: year, month, startyear, turnterm, develcost, isunited, turntime, hiddenSeed
state.nation: whole table ORDER BY nation ASC
state.city: whole table ORDER BY city ASC
state.general: whole table ORDER BY no ASC
state.diplomacy: whole table ORDER BY no ASC
state.nation_env: KV rows ORDER BY firstColumn ASC

capture-NN-year-YYY-month-M.json.reachedMaxTurns: bool — true only for the final max-turns boundary snapshot
capture-NN-year-YYY-month-M.json.monthlySeedString: string — the serialized monthly RNG seed, built from OLD date (pre-turnDate year,month)
capture-NN-year-YYY-month-M.json.monthlyRngDraws: int|null — draw count via LiteHashDRBG reflection
capture-NN-year-YYY-month-M.json.preMonthDispatchOrder: array of {id, priority, target} — event execution order BEFORE PreMonth
capture-NN-year-YYY-month-M.json.monthDispatchOrder: array of {id, priority, target} — event execution order BEFORE Month
capture-NN-year-YYY-month-M.json.recordRows: array of {id, general_id, log_type, year, month, text} — general_record rows added since last capture point, ORDER BY id ASC

manifest_longsim.json.reachedMaxTurns: bool — true if the sim ended by hitting maxTurns without unification
manifest_longsim.json.points: array of {index, file, gameMonths, year, month, isunited, reachedMaxTurns, rngDraws, recordCount}

matchedCountGate._policy: State snapshot byte-match at each capture point (every 12 months + at unification). The per-table numeric state is the oracle; per-general command sequences are NOT asserted.
assertedFacts: monthlySeedString is built from OLD date (pre-turnDate year,month) — the Kotlin gate must use the same date when constructing the monthly RNG
monthlySeedString byte-match at each capture point
event dispatch ordering invariant (priority DESC, id ASC)

quarantine: Per-general command RNG draws are NOT instrumented — only the monthly RNG draw count is captured. Existing P2 per-command gates cover per-general RNG parity.
Tournament (processTournament) and auction (processAuction) real-time infrastructure is skipped — these are not monthly-bound deterministic state mutators.
NPC AI command choices (GeneralAI.chooseNationTurn / chooseGeneralTurn) are seed-dependent and may diverge from the Kotlin AI port. The long-sim gate compares state snapshots, not command sequences.
No human-player commands are exercised; the sim is NPC/autorun only.
Early months on a pristine install may have zero per-general command drain until turntime advances via updateTurnTime(). This is parity-faithful.
Unification is not guaranteed in an NPC-only sim; the maxTurns boundary emits a partial snapshot with reachedMaxTurns=true.
